name: Mosscloak Maze
introDiscord:
A maze of moss-covered roots closes around the trail. Mosscloak
Octopuses vanish against nearly any surface, meaning every perfectly
ordinary patch of greenery is now legally suspicious.
introTwitch:
A maze of moss-covered roots closes around the trail. Mosscloak
Octopuses vanish against nearly any surface, meaning every perfectly
ordinary patch of greenery is now legally suspicious.

mosscloak-maze-approach.prompt: Three mossy corridors twist ahead. One wall appears to be breathing.

left.message:
You inspect a patch of moss.

Normal.

Another patch.

Normal.

A third patch grows eight arms.

There it is.

right.message:
One Berry sits beneath Shizuki's note:

'Spent twenty minutes talking to moss.

Moss was Octopus.

Octopus did not correct me.

Social betrayal.'

forward.message:
An offering basket hides inside a living root. The moss covering it
slides away when you reach for the Star Candies.

The moss has eyes.

You choose not to investigate.

mosscloak-maze-depths.prompt:
Living roots divide into three passages covered in nearly identical
green growth.

left.message:
A moonblossom pool rests beneath Shizuki's inspection sign:

'POOL: real.
ROCK: real.
MOSS: questionable.
ME: tired.'
left.fullHpMessage:
You leave the restorative pool untouched and accept Shizuki's official
moss classification.

right.message:
A moss-covered stone shifts aside.

Eight arms unfold.

You are beginning to resent environmental décor.

forward.message:
Broad silver kelp hides a cache of Star Candies.

You poke the kelp first.

Nothing moves.

Progress.

mosscloak-maze-threshold.prompt:
Moonlit fronds surround Green Masquerade, where every wall, root, and
stone wears the same thick emerald moss.

left.message:
A shrine coffer sits behind a curtain of moss.

The curtain politely hands you the latch.

It is an Octopus.

Apparently even camouflage creatures can be helpful.

right.message:
Restorative sap rests beneath Shizuki's note:

'Medicine real.

Bottle real.

Table was Octopus.

Still upset.'
right.fullHpMessage:
You leave the medicine untouched. The table incident remains
emotionally unresolved.

forward.message:
A completely ordinary root blocks the route.

It becomes an Octopus.

Nothing is ordinary anymore.

boss-antechamber.name: Green Masquerade
boss-antechamber.prompt: Every patch of moss in Green Masquerade changes color simultaneously.

bossPromptDiscord:
The walls move.

Then the floor.

Then half the chamber peels itself away from the roots.

What looked like an overgrown grove has been hiding one enormous
presence in plain sight.

Use /yes to enter Green Masquerade or /no to reconsider every piece of
moss you have ever trusted.
bossPromptTwitch:
The walls move.

Then the floor.

Then half the chamber peels itself away from the roots.

What looked like an overgrown grove has been hiding one enormous
presence in plain sight.

Use !yes to enter Green Masquerade or !no to reconsider every piece of
moss you have ever trusted.
bossRetreatText:
You retreat from Green Masquerade.

Behind you, the entire chamber becomes perfectly ordinary greenery
again.

Absolutely not.

boss.revealText:
Eight enormous arms unfold from the moss-covered walls.

Ancient Mosscloak reveals itself!

completionText:
"The Ancient Mosscloak disappears back into the forest.

You know it is somewhere nearby.

The forest looks completely normal.

This is no longer comforting."
